market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: OPEC March 2026 reading ~1.095m bpd; April exports surged to 1.23m but production figure trails. Hitting 1.4m would require ~28% jump from current production with infrastructure constraints and US sanctions wavering. Unlikely without major policy shift.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sanctions relief / Chevron asset deals accelerating capacity.
